notes: Pokémon editor — first edit: make party Pokémon shiny. In a Gen 3 game's Edit save dialog, your Party now shows a ★ next to each Pokémon — tap it and Apply to make that Pokémon shiny (or not). It's done legally: only the shininess changes, the species, nature, gender, ability and IVs are kept, and the save is backed up first. Verified on a real Emerald save. Next: IV/EV and move editing, then one-tap event Pokémon.
